payload.title: Three Witnesses, One Room — Open File
payload.summary: A ledger vanished during seven minutes at the banquet. Employer Valenti demands that Orsini be named because a gray coat left the room. The clothing, its wearer, and the ledger are separate questions.

commitments: Fictional decisions; no currency or player property is at stake.

quality.question: Who carried ledger LA-17 through the east door, and what does each independent record establish?

assumptions.text: All times use the same local clock unless a record explicitly gives a correction.
Only named people and mechanisms in the case can be required for its resolution.

clauses.text: An absent departure is informative only if every departure required an entry and the complete relevant source was checked.
Only LA-17 has the recorded brass-corner repair; color alone does not distinguish the ledger.

identity.emotionalTurn: An accusation becomes a bounded account of what really happened

motives.label: Protect people affected by the case

questions.text: Every record below uses the corrected hall clock. Learn how the correction works, or apply the procedure you already demonstrated.
At the same instant the bell record reads 19:00 and the hall clock reads 19:02. A hall photograph reads 19:08. Which corrected time belongs to it?
The corrected timestamps are printed below. Place the contact sheets in time order before using the east-door image.
The inventory registers LA-17 as a blue ledger with a repaired brass corner. A blue hymnbook has an unmarked spine. Which feature can distinguish the photographed book?
Dario: “I watched Luca trade his blue coat for the gray one at 19:04. I called the gray coat Orsini because that is what we call it. I did not see Orsini’s face.” Select what Dario directly observed.
The east-door clerk recorded each departing guest, checked a face against the guest card, and signed the entry. Luca’s checked entry is at 19:06. Match the entry to what it establishes.

The checked receipt says ledger LA-17 was placed in the gray coat’s inside pocket before Luca collected that coat. The gray coat’s outside pocket held a menu. Choose the record relevant to the ledger.

A red envelope looks official. The printed seal register says theater props use red wax and official notices use embossed white paper. The envelope contains a theater seating plan. Which record closes this lead?

A clerk confirms that every east-door departure required a checked, signed face entry, and checks the complete 19:03–19:07 list. What must be established before Orsini’s absence from that list can count?
Valenti: “I asked for Orsini.” The supported finding names Luca’s departure; it does not prove a theft motive. Decide what work you are prepared to do.
The archive lending slip is signed before the banquet and identifies Luca as the authorized restorer. Match permission to the record that grants it.
Which statement stays within the proof you collected?
Dario accepts the correction without retracting what he actually saw. Valenti still believes Orsini arranged the evening. You can disagree and complete the commissioned factual account.
Who carried LA-17, and which independent records support that?
Which acquired observation can correct Rosa’s sincere identification?

npcs.label: Dario
npcs.voice: Short practical sentences; distinguishes what he watched from what he called it.

npcs.label: Valenti
npcs.voice: Speaks in demands and reputational costs.
principles: He will accept a signed factual file even when he dislikes its finding.

npcs.label: Rosa
npcs.voice: Names familiar things confidently, then acknowledges the exact limit of her observation.

recipients.label: Show Rosa the acquired face image
recipients.report: Rosa examines the image and agrees to revisit her identification.
